message: As someone who loves to be ready for anything, I find it super helpful to revisit resources on how to handle blackouts. They’re not just about candles and flashlights; it’s about keeping things calm and collected when the lights go out. I’ve found that having a plan in place makes all the difference — and trust me, it’s more about the little things than you might think! What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when the power goes out? 💡
